name: Inference Recommendation Engine
audience_feeling: I can see why this route ranked here, change the weights, and reproduce the result locally.
promise: Turn noisy inference trade-offs into an inspectable recommendation you can adjust and test.
visual_identity: Anime-inspired editorial scenes with a recurring maintainer and friendly robot companion; clean decision boards make price, supply, evidence, and policy visible without implying live provider guarantees.

preferred_terms.recommendation: a policy-scored candidate, not a guarantee
preferred_terms.availability: observed supply or provider breadth, named precisely
preferred_terms.reliability: runtime evidence with a stated sample and confidence rule
preferred_terms.ranking: deterministic output for a fixed candidate pool and policy

good_examples: A cheap outlier should not outweigh a well-supplied price tier by accident.
The policy makes the trade-off visible, editable, and testable.
Top candidates stay visible even when a gate explains why they are not routable yet.
bad_examples: The engine knows the best model for every task.
The cheapest model is automatically the best choice.
